verdicts.reason: A works as one centred cluster of bottle and text that reads left to right, but the end of the headline runs into the green circle, the CTA is crammed tight under the subcopy, and the content sits squeezed in the middle with empty margins on both sides. B's text block has no shared axis: SOLSTICE, the headline and the subcopy are each centred on a different point, and the CTA is left-aligned under them. The subcopy also wraps to an awkward 'lightly sweet.' line, the bottle is pushed against the left edge, and the decorative circles have shrunk to two random dots stacked on the right.
